clips.title: The story
paras: Discipline is a task issued by Executor Zygand in Tirisfal Glades. Unimpressed by the competence of the local Deathguard garrison, Zygand commissions outside adventurers to administer physical punishment to slackening undead sentries.

The Deathguard form the military spine of the Forsaken across Lordaeron, but freedom from the Lich King's iron will brings its own complications: apathy, fatigue, and negligence. Taskmasters like Executor Zygand have little patience for slackening discipline, especially with threats from the Scarlet Crusade and Scourge prowling Tirisfal's borders. To keep the troops sharp, officers rely on blunt instruments and aggressive oversight to maintain military readiness.

Executor Zygand deliberately employs independent operators rather than ranks from within the garrison to administer his punishments. Using the Executor's Motivator, outsiders remind negligent Deathguards that survival in service to the Dark Lady requires absolute vigilance. Those who fail in their duties quickly learn that unlife offers no shelter from consequence.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.
As a reward for your lack of incompetence, you shall be rewarded with punishing those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.
Swiftly now--friend, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There are precious few delights afforded to us in death. Thankfully, pain is chief among them.
You please me this day, and therefore you please the Dark Lady. Perhaps you can be of further use.
